rbi_sf_2025_26.title: State Finances: A Study of Budgets of 2025-26
rbi_sf_2025_26.originating_agency: Budget documents of the State governments

AP-FINANCE-ACCOUNTS.title: Finance Accounts of Andhra Pradesh (Volumes I and II), Accountant General (A&E)
AP-FINANCE-ACCOUNTS.publisher: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
AP-FINANCE-ACCOUNTS.note: The audited, certified statement of what the state received and spent. The authority both the Reserve Bank and the state's own budget books are ultimately reporting.

unavailable.what: State GST, sales tax/VAT, state excise, stamps and registration, and motor vehicle tax, as separate yearly series for Andhra Pradesh
unavailable.what_a_human_should_do: RBI's Handbook publishes only the own-tax-revenue aggregate (Table 168). The component breakdown is in 'State Finances: A Study of Budgets 2025-26', Appendix Table on Revenue Receipts of State Governments, and in the e-STATES Excel database on the same page. Download the e-STATES Excel workbook (rbi.org.in > Publications > Annual > State Finances: A Study of Budgets 2025-26 > e-STATES Database) and read the Andhra Pradesh sheet; it carries the tax-head split back to 1990-91. Also cross-check against the AP Budget in Brief, Annexure on Revenue Receipts.

Not in the RBI Handbook at all. The last hard number is Census 2011, which is undivided Andhra Pradesh; there is no post-bifurcation census. For a residuary-state figure use NSO's Periodic Labour Force Survey annual report, Statement on literacy rate of persons aged 7 years and above by state, or NFHS-5 (2019-21) state fact sheet for Andhra Pradesh on rchiips.org/nfhs.

Not in the RBI Handbook. Use the SRS Statistical Report annual series (sex ratio at birth by state) from the Office of the Registrar General, censusindia.gov.in > Vital Statistics > SRS Statistical Report, or NFHS-5 for the population sex ratio.

unavailable.what: Number of registered motor vehicles in Andhra Pradesh
unavailable.what_a_human_should_do: The MoRTH site is JavaScript-rendered and returned no content here. Open morth.gov.in > Statistics & Publications > Road Transport Year Book, download the latest edition PDF, and read Table 4.1 'Total number of registered motor vehicles in India' state-wise. The live per-state count is also on the Vahan dashboard at vahan.parivahan.gov.in > Vahan 4 Dashboard.

unavailable.what: Ports and cargo handled at Andhra Pradesh ports
unavailable.what_a_human_should_do: Not in the RBI Handbook. For the major port (Visakhapatnam) use the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways 'Basic Port Statistics of India' annual PDF at shipmin.gov.in > Statistics. For the non-major ports (Krishnapatnam, Gangavaram, Kakinada, Machilipatnam) use the same publication's non-major-ports table, which reports by maritime state.

unavailable.what: Foreign direct investment inflows into Andhra Pradesh
unavailable.what_a_human_should_do: Not in the RBI Handbook. DPIIT's quarterly FDI factsheet reports inflows by RBI regional office, not by state; the Hyderabad regional office covers both Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. Download the latest 'FDI Factsheet' from dpiit.gov.in > Publications > FDI Statistics and read Table 'FDI equity inflows - RBI's regional office'. A true state figure requires the AP Economic Development Board or the AP Socio-Economic Survey chapter on Industries.

unavailable.what: Number of operational land holdings in Andhra Pradesh
unavailable.what_a_human_should_do: Not in the RBI Handbook. Download the Agriculture Census 2015-16 and 2021-22 All India Report on Number and Area of Operational Holdings from agcensus.da.gov.in, and read the state table for Andhra Pradesh.

unavailable.what: Number of registered companies in Andhra Pradesh
unavailable.what_a_human_should_do: Not in the RBI Handbook. Ministry of Corporate Affairs publishes a Monthly Information Bulletin on Corporate Sector with a state-wise table of companies registered and active. Download the latest bulletin PDF from mca.gov.in > Data & Reports > Monthly Information Bulletin.

unavailable.what: Housing indicators for Andhra Pradesh (houses completed under PMAY, housing stock)
unavailable.what_a_human_should_do: Not in the RBI Handbook. Use the PMAY-Gramin dashboard at pmayg.nic.in > Reports > Physical Progress Report, selecting Andhra Pradesh; and PMAY-Urban at pmay-urban.gov.in > Progress. For housing stock, Census 2011 Houselisting tables (undivided state only).

unavailable.what: Labour force participation rate and worker population ratio for Andhra Pradesh
unavailable.what_a_human_should_do: The RBI Handbook prints only the unemployment rate (Tables 8 and 9), not LFPR or WPR. Download the PLFS Annual Report for each year from mospi.gov.in > Publications & Reports > Periodic Labour Force Survey, and read Statement 12 (LFPR) and Statement 14 (WPR) in the state-wise appendix, usual status (ps+ss), for Andhra Pradesh.

unavailable.what: CPI index levels and rural/urban split for Andhra Pradesh
unavailable.what_a_human_should_do: The Handbook Tables 108-111 print only average inflation rates, combined, not index levels and not the rural/urban split. Download the monthly CPI state-wise index files from mospi.gov.in > Data > Consumer Price Index, or the CPI series on esankhyiki.mospi.gov.in, and filter to Andhra Pradesh, Rural / Urban / Combined.

unavailable.what: Table 142, State-wise Actual Power Supply Position (peak demand versus peak met)
unavailable.what_a_human_should_do: The page was fetched but each year carries four sub-columns (peak demand, peak met, surplus/deficit, per cent) and the row could not be split reliably by automated extraction. Open the page, or the full Handbook PDF, and read Table 142's Andhra Pradesh row by eye. The same applies to Table 179 (NPS subscribers) and Table 180 (Atal Pension Yojana enrolments), which have Female/Male/Transgender sub-columns per year.

unavailable.what: A machine-readable copy of the whole Handbook
unavailable.what_a_human_should_do: Every table on that page has an 'Excel' download link next to the HTML view. Downloading the ~182 Excel files, or the single full-Handbook PDF at the top of the page, removes all transcription risk and gives the sub-column structure that defeated automated reading of Tables 142, 179 and 180.

unavailable.what: Andhra Pradesh's own official figures, which often differ from the central series
unavailable.what_a_human_should_do: Download the AP Socio-Economic Survey PDFs (editions 2017-18 through 2024-25 are all listed and linked on that page; the 2024-25 file is AP_Socio_Economic_Survey_2024_25.pdf). These carry district-level detail, irrigation project status, welfare-scheme beneficiary counts and the state's own GSDP estimates - none of which the RBI Handbook contains.

indicators.label: Gross State Domestic Product at constant (2011-12) prices
indicators.what: The total value of everything the state produced in a year after stripping out price rises, so it only goes up when the state actually makes more.
indicators.table: Table 22: Gross State Domestic Product (Constant Prices)

indicators.label: Gross State Domestic Product at current prices
indicators.what: The total rupee value of everything the state produced in a year, counted at the prices of that year, so it grows both when more is made and when prices go up.
indicators.table: Table 21: Gross State Domestic Product (Current Prices)

indicators.label: Gross State Value Added - Agriculture, at constant (2011-12) prices
indicators.what: The value of the state's farming, forestry and fishing output with price changes removed, so it moves with the size of the harvest rather than the price of it.
indicators.table: Table 30: Gross State Value Added by Economic Activity - Agriculture (Constant Prices)

indicators.label: Gross State Value Added - Agriculture, at current prices
indicators.what: The value of the state's farming, forestry and fishing output for the year, at that year's prices.
indicators.table: Table 29: Gross State Value Added by Economic Activity - Agriculture (Current Prices)

indicators.label: Gross State Value Added - Construction, at current prices
indicators.what: The value of building work - houses, roads, dams - done in the year, at that year's prices.
indicators.table: Table 37: Gross State Value Added by Economic Activity - Construction (Current Prices)

indicators.label: Gross State Value Added - Financial Services, at current prices
indicators.what: The value added by banks, insurance, and real-estate services in the year, at that year's prices.
indicators.table: Table 45: Gross State Value Added by Economic Activity - Financial Services (Current Prices)

indicators.label: Gross State Value Added - Industry, at constant (2011-12) prices
indicators.what: The value produced by mines, factories and power plants with price changes removed (building work is counted separately).
indicators.table: Table 42: Gross State Value Added by Economic Activity - Industry (Constant Prices)

indicators.label: Gross State Value Added - Industry, at current prices
indicators.what: The value produced by mines, factories and power plants in the year, at that year's prices (building work is counted separately).
indicators.table: Table 41: Gross State Value Added by Economic Activity - Industry (Current Prices)

indicators.label: Gross State Value Added - Manufacturing, at current prices
indicators.what: The value added by factories alone in the year, at that year's prices.
indicators.table: Table 33: Gross State Value Added by Economic Activity - Manufacturing (Current Prices)

indicators.label: Gross State Value Added - Services (excl. financial services), at constant (2011-12) prices
indicators.what: The value of services such as trade, transport, hotels, education and government with price changes removed (banking and insurance are counted separately).
indicators.table: Table 50: Gross State Value Added by Economic Activity - Services (Constant Prices)

indicators.label: Gross State Value Added - Services (excl. financial services), at current prices
indicators.what: The value of services such as trade, transport, hotels, education and government, at that year's prices (banking and insurance are counted separately).
indicators.table: Table 49: Gross State Value Added by Economic Activity - Services (Current Prices)

indicators.label: Net State Domestic Product at current prices
indicators.what: The state's total output for the year at that year's prices, after subtracting the wear and tear on machines, roads and buildings.
indicators.table: Table 23: Net State Domestic Product (Current Prices)

indicators.label: Per capita Net State Domestic Product at constant (2011-12) prices
indicators.what: Average income per person after removing the effect of rising prices, which is the closest single number to whether people are actually better off.
indicators.table: Table 20: Per Capita Net State Domestic Product (Constant Prices)

indicators.label: Per capita Net State Domestic Product at current prices
indicators.what: The state's yearly income divided by the number of people living there, measured in that year's prices, so inflation pushes it up too.
indicators.table: Table 19: Per Capita Net State Domestic Product (Current Prices)

indicators.label: Capital expenditure
indicators.what: Spending that creates or buys lasting things - roads, canals, buildings - plus loans the state gives out.
indicators.table: Table 173: State-wise Capital Expenditure

indicators.label: Capital outlay
indicators.what: The part of state spending that actually builds physical assets the state will own, such as irrigation works and roads.
indicators.table: Table 174: State-wise Capital Outlay

indicators.label: Capital receipts
indicators.what: All the money the state takes in that is not income - chiefly fresh borrowing and loan recoveries, including short-term borrowing rolled over many times in a year.
indicators.table: Table 172: State-wise Capital Receipts

indicators.label: Development expenditure
indicators.what: Everything the state spends on things meant to improve the economy and people's lives - schools, health, farming, roads, power - rather than on administration, police and debt service.
indicators.table: Statement 11: Development Expenditure

indicators.label: Devolution and transfer of resources from the Centre (gross)
indicators.what: Money the state receives from the national government - its share of national taxes plus grants.
indicators.table: Statement 17: Devolution and Transfer of Resources from the Centre

indicators.label: Gross fiscal deficit
indicators.what: How much more the state government spent than it took in during the year, which it had to borrow.
indicators.table: Table 164: State-wise Gross Fiscal Deficit

indicators.label: Gross market borrowings of the state government
indicators.what: How much the state raised in the year by selling bonds to investors.
indicators.table: Table 178: Market Borrowings of State Governments

indicators.label: Interest payments
indicators.what: The yearly cost of servicing the state's borrowings, before repaying any of the principal.
indicators.table: Table 170: State-wise Interest Payments

indicators.label: Outstanding guarantees of the state government
indicators.what: Debts of state-owned companies that the state government has promised to repay if those companies cannot - money it does not owe yet but might.
indicators.table: Table 177: State-wise Outstanding Guarantees of State Governments

indicators.label: Own non-tax revenue
indicators.what: Money the state earns without taxing - fees, interest, dividends from state companies, and charges for services.
indicators.table: Table 169: State-wise Own Non-Tax Revenue

indicators.label: Own tax revenue
indicators.what: The money the state raises itself through taxes it controls, such as GST on goods sold in the state, liquor duty and stamp duty.
indicators.table: Table 168: State-wise Own Tax Revenue

indicators.label: Pension payments
indicators.what: What the state pays every year to its retired employees.
indicators.table: Table 171: State-wise Pension

indicators.label: Primary deficit
indicators.what: The gap between what the state spends and earns, leaving out the interest it owes on past debt.
indicators.table: Table 167: State-wise Primary Deficit

indicators.label: Revenue deficit
indicators.what: Borrowing used to pay for day-to-day running costs like salaries and subsidies rather than to build anything; a negative number means there was a surplus instead.
indicators.table: Table 165: State-wise Revenue Deficit

indicators.label: Revenue expenditure
indicators.what: Everything the state spends on running itself for the year - salaries, pensions, subsidies, interest and upkeep - as opposed to building new assets.
indicators.table: Table 166: State-wise Revenue Expenditure

indicators.label: Social sector expenditure
indicators.what: What the state spends on people - schools, hospitals, water supply, housing, welfare payments.
indicators.table: Table 175: State-wise Social Sector Expenditure

indicators.label: Total outstanding liabilities as per cent of GSDP
indicators.what: The state's total debt measured against the size of its economy, which is the usual way of asking whether the debt is manageable.
indicators.table: Statement 20: Total Outstanding Liabilities - As per cent of GSDP

indicators.label: Total outstanding liabilities of the state government
indicators.what: The total the state government owes at the end of the year, adding up every year of past borrowing.
indicators.table: Statement 19: Total Outstanding Liabilities of State Governments

indicators.label: Birth rate
indicators.what: How many babies are born in a year for every thousand people living in the state.
indicators.table: Table 2: State-wise Birth Rate

indicators.label: Death rate
indicators.what: How many people die in a year for every thousand living in the state.
indicators.table: Table 3: State-wise Death Rate

indicators.label: Doctors in position at primary health centres
indicators.what: How many doctors are actually working in the state's village-level primary health centres.
indicators.table: Table 16: State-wise Health Infrastructure - Doctors and Specialists

indicators.label: Domestic tourist visits
indicators.what: How many visits Indian tourists made to the state during the year.
indicators.table: Table 13: State-wise Domestic Tourist Visits

indicators.label: Expenditure on relief on natural calamities
indicators.what: What the state spent responding to floods, cyclones, droughts and other disasters during the year.
indicators.table: Table 105: State-wise Expenditure on Relief on Natural Calamities

indicators.label: Foreign tourist visits
indicators.what: How many visits foreign tourists made to the state during the year.
indicators.table: Table 182: State-wise Foreign Tourist Visits

indicators.label: Forest cover
indicators.what: How much of the state is covered by forest.
indicators.table: Table 99: State-wise Forest Cover

indicators.label: Gross enrolment ratio, secondary stage (Class IX-XII), total
indicators.what: How many children are enrolled in classes 9 to 12 compared with the number of children of that age in the state.
indicators.table: Table 1: State-wise Gross Enrolment Ratio - 2024-25

indicators.label: Infant mortality rate
indicators.what: Out of every thousand babies born alive, how many die before their first birthday.
indicators.table: Table 4: State-wise Infant Mortality Rate

indicators.label: Life expectancy at birth (total)
indicators.what: How long a baby born now could expect to live if health conditions stayed as they are today.
indicators.table: Table 7: State-wise Life Expectancy

indicators.label: Maternal mortality ratio
indicators.what: Out of every hundred thousand babies born alive, how many mothers die from causes related to pregnancy or childbirth.
indicators.table: Table 5: State-wise Maternal Mortality Ratio

indicators.label: Multidimensional poverty headcount ratio
indicators.what: The share of people who are short on several basic things at once - such as schooling, nutrition, cooking fuel, sanitation and electricity.
indicators.table: Table 10: State-wise Poverty Estimates - Multi-dimensional Poverty Index

indicators.label: Number of schools
indicators.what: How many schools of all kinds there are in the state.
indicators.table: Table 151: State-wise Number of Schools by Management and Availability of Functional Computer Facility, 2024-25

indicators.label: Public expenditure on health
indicators.what: How much government money was spent on health in the state in the year.
indicators.table: Table 18: State-wise Public Expenditure on Health

indicators.label: Total fertility rate
indicators.unit: (no unit printed; average number of children expected to be born per woman)
indicators.what: The average number of children a woman would have over her lifetime at current birth patterns.
indicators.table: Table 6: State-wise Total Fertility Rate

indicators.label: Availability of power
indicators.what: How much electricity was actually supplied to users in the state over the year.
indicators.table: Table 139: State-wise Availability of Power

indicators.label: Electricity transmission and distribution losses
indicators.what: The share of electricity that is lost or unpaid for between the power station and the customer.
indicators.table: Table 148: State-wise Electricity Transmission & Distribution Losses

indicators.label: Exports from the state
indicators.what: The value of goods sold abroad from the state in a year, measured in US dollars.
indicators.table: Table 181: State-wise Exports

indicators.label: Installed capacity of power
indicators.what: The maximum amount of electricity the state's power stations could produce at once if everything ran flat out.
indicators.table: Table 140: State-wise Installed Capacity of Power

indicators.label: Length of national highways
indicators.what: How many kilometres of national highway run through the state.
indicators.table: Table 144: State-wise Length of National Highways

indicators.label: Length of state highways
indicators.what: How many kilometres of highway the state government itself maintains.
indicators.table: Table 147: State-wise Length of State Highways

indicators.label: Number of factories (ASI)
indicators.what: How many registered factories were operating in the state.
indicators.table: Table 116: State-wise Number of Factories

indicators.label: Number of factory workers (ASI)
indicators.what: How many people work on the floor of the state's registered factories.
indicators.table: Table 122: State-wise Number of Workers

indicators.label: Per capita availability of power
indicators.what: How much electricity was supplied per person in the state over the year.
indicators.table: Table 138: State-wise Per Capita Availability of Power

indicators.label: Railway route length
indicators.what: How many kilometres of railway line run through the state.
indicators.table: Table 145: State-wise Railway Route

indicators.label: Road constructed under PMGSY (cumulative)
indicators.what: The running total of all-weather village roads built in the state under the national rural roads programme.
indicators.table: Table 150: State-wise Road Constructed under PMGSY

indicators.label: Telephones per 100 population
indicators.what: How many working phone connections there are for every hundred people.
indicators.table: Table 149: State-wise Telephones per 100 Population

indicators.label: Total installed capacity of grid-interactive renewable power
indicators.what: How much solar, wind and other renewable generating capacity is connected to the state's grid.
indicators.table: Table 143: State-wise Total Installed Capacity of Grid Interactive Renewable Power

indicators.label: Total length of roads
indicators.what: The total length of all roads of every kind in the state.
indicators.table: Table 146: State-wise Length of Roads

indicators.label: Average daily wage rate, rural men, general agricultural labourers
indicators.what: What a man doing ordinary farm labour in a village is paid for a day's work.
indicators.table: Table 113: State-wise Average Daily Wage Rates in Rural India (Men - General Agricultural Labourers)

indicators.label: Bank credit to agriculture
indicators.what: The total amount banks have lent to farmers and farm businesses in the state.
indicators.table: Table 157: State-wise Credit to Agriculture by Scheduled Commercial Banks

indicators.label: Consumption of fertiliser (N, P & K)
indicators.what: How much chemical fertiliser the state's farmers used in the year; more can mean more crops but also more strain on the soil and a bigger subsidy bill.
indicators.table: Table 89: State-wise Consumption of Fertiliser (N,P&K)

indicators.label: Gross irrigated area
indicators.what: The total irrigated area counting a field twice if it is watered for two crops in the same year.
indicators.table: Table 55: State-wise Pattern of Land Use - Gross Irrigated Area

indicators.label: Net irrigated area
indicators.what: How much land in the state gets water from canals, tanks or wells rather than depending on rain, counting each field once.
indicators.table: Table 56: State-wise Pattern of Land Use - Net Irrigated Area

indicators.label: Production of rice
indicators.what: How much rice the state's farms produced in the year.
indicators.table: Table 58: State-wise Production of Foodgrains - Rice

indicators.label: Production of total foodgrains
indicators.what: How much rice, wheat, other cereals and pulses the state's farms produced in the year.
indicators.table: Table 62: State-wise Production of Total Foodgrains

indicators.label: Bank credit to industry
indicators.what: The total amount banks have lent to industrial businesses in the state.
indicators.table: Table 158: State-wise Credit to Industry by Scheduled Commercial Banks

indicators.label: Credit from scheduled commercial banks
indicators.what: The total money banks have lent out in the state.
indicators.table: Table 156: State-wise Credit by Scheduled Commercial Banks in India

indicators.label: Credit of regional rural banks
indicators.what: Money lent out by the small village-focused banks that serve rural customers.
indicators.table: Table 161: State-wise Credit of Regional Rural Banks

indicators.label: Credit-deposit ratio (place of sanction)
indicators.what: For every 100 rupees deposited in the state's banks, how many rupees are lent out by branches in the state.
indicators.table: Table 153: State-wise Credit-Deposit Ratio of Scheduled Commercial Banks According to Place of Sanction

indicators.label: Credit-deposit ratio (place of utilisation)
indicators.what: For every 100 rupees deposited in the state's banks, how many rupees are lent out for use in the state.
indicators.table: Table 154: State-wise Credit-Deposit Ratio of Scheduled Commercial Banks According to Place of Utilisation

indicators.label: Credit-deposit ratio of regional rural banks
indicators.what: For every 100 rupees deposited in the state's rural banks, how many rupees they lend back out.
indicators.table: Table 162: State-wise Credit-Deposit Ratio of Regional Rural Banks

indicators.label: Deposits of regional rural banks
indicators.what: Money held in the small village-focused banks that serve rural customers.
indicators.table: Table 160: State-wise Deposits of Regional Rural Banks

indicators.label: Deposits with scheduled commercial banks
indicators.what: The total money people and businesses in the state keep in their bank accounts.
indicators.table: Table 155: State-wise Deposits by Scheduled Commercial Banks in India

indicators.label: Number of branches of regional rural banks
indicators.what: How many branches the small village-focused rural banks have in the state.
indicators.table: Table 163: State-wise Number of Branches of Regional Rural Banks

indicators.label: Number of offices of scheduled commercial banks
indicators.unit: Number of Offices as at end-March
indicators.what: How many bank branches there are in the state.
indicators.table: Table 152: State-wise Distribution of Offices of Scheduled Commercial Banks

indicators.label: Personal loans from scheduled commercial banks
indicators.what: The total borrowed by households in the state for homes, vehicles, education and other personal spending.
indicators.table: Table 159: State-wise Personal Loans by Scheduled Commercial Banks

indicators.label: Unemployment rate, rural, usual status (adjusted), persons
indicators.what: Out of every thousand village people who want work, how many cannot find any.
indicators.table: Table 8: State-wise Unemployment Rate: Usual Status (Adjusted) (Rural)

indicators.label: Unemployment rate, urban, usual status (adjusted), persons
indicators.what: Out of every thousand town and city people who want work, how many cannot find any.
indicators.table: Table 9: State-wise Unemployment Rate: Usual Status (Adjusted) (Urban)

indicators.label: Average CPI inflation - Food and Beverages
indicators.what: How much more expensive food and drink became over the year.
indicators.table: Table 109: State-wise Average Inflation (CPI) - Food and Beverages

indicators.label: Average CPI inflation - General
indicators.what: How much more expensive the typical basket of things a household buys became over the year.
indicators.table: Table 108: State-wise Average Inflation (CPI) - General
